snippet.title: Tangy TD - Game Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Add to Wishlists on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245620/Cakez_TD?utm_source=YouTube

Tower defense with class based Tangy such as defender, archer and healer. Upgrade them through meta progression skill trees to unlock new ways to play and become stronger. Merge and equip items to discover new mechanics. Explore maps, bosses, map obstacles and recruit new Tangy types to your roster.

*About Me*
Hey! And welcome. I'm an indie game developer, currently working on a Tower Defense Game written entirely in C/C++, I tried using Unity or Unreal Engine in the past, but never really found much success. I'm mostly posting devlog / devblog videos where I show off the progress I make on the game.
